announce.actionFailed.description: Announced and listed when a session or host action fails.

announce.daemonRemoveFailed.description: Announced and listed when removing the daemon fails.

announce.findMatch.description: Announced as find selects a match.

announce.hostDisconnected.description: Announced and listed when a working connection ends.

announce.reviewOutput.defaultMessage: New output. {keys} goes to the end.

announce.scrollbackCleared.description: Announced after Clear scrollback deleted the open session’s scrollback.

announce.settingsNotSaved.defaultMessage: Couldn’t save the settings, so they are back as they were.

announce.tabMovesFocus.defaultMessage: Tab moves focus out of the terminal.

announce.unmuted.description: Announced when output announcements are unmuted for a session.

announce.zoom.description: Announced after the terminal text size changes.

announce.zoomSmallest.description: Announced when the terminal text cannot shrink any more.

background.bell.description: The session’s program rang the bell.

background.command.description: A long command finished, as shell integration marked it.

clipboard.written.defaultMessage: A program on {host} put text on the clipboard.

close.body.defaultMessage: TRC stops {session} on {host} if it is running, then deletes the session and its scrollback. This can’t be undone.

command.commandPrevious.description: Command name: goes to the command before, as shell integration marked it (US-5.2).

command.commandReadOutput.description: Command name: speaks the output of the last command that ran (US-5.2).

command.quitAndStopAll.description: Command name; asks before it stops every session on every connected host and quits.

command.sessionNewWithOptions.description: Command name: opens the New session dialog.

command.sessionQuickSwitch.description: Command name: opens the quick switcher, a filterable list of every session on every host (US-5.4).

command.terminalClearScrollback.description: Command name: deletes the open session’s scrollback, on the host’s disk too.

command.terminalListLinks.description: Command name: lists the links on the terminal screen to open one (US-1.12.3).

command.terminalToggleTabFocus.description: Command name: toggles whether Tab leaves the terminal.

copy.capped.defaultMessage: Copied all {lines, number} lines. Assistive technology sees the first {cap, number}.

details.detached.defaultMessage: On its own, outside any service manager

details.installRoot.description: Label of the read-only field holding the daemon’s install location.

details.launchd.defaultMessage: As a LaunchAgent, which starts at login

details.lessThanAMinute.description: The daemon’s uptime when it started a moment ago.

details.logs.description: Label of the read-only field holding the folder of the daemon’s logs.

details.remove.description: Button that asks for confirmation first.

details.savingFails.defaultMessage: Fails for {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}: {reason}

details.unknownService.defaultMessage: In a way this version does not know

logoutWarning.body.defaultMessage: {host} ends your processes when your last connection to it closes, and lingering is off for your user, so the programs in its sessions end when TRC’s connection closes. TRC brings the sessions back below their saved scrollback the next time it connects, each in a new shell. To keep programs running, ask the host’s administrator to enable lingering for your user (loginctl enable-linger).
